I posted a guard at my mouth,
when a sinner took up a position against me.
and I was quiet before good things,
My heart grew hot within me, and,
et in meditatione mea exardescet ignis.
during my meditation, a fire would flare up.
Locutus sum in lingua mea: Notum fac mihi,
I spoke with my tongue, “O Lord,
et numerum dierum meorum quis est,
and what the number of my days will be,
so that I may know what is lacking to me.”
Behold, you have made my days measurable,
et substantia mea tamquam nihilum ante te.
and, before you, my substance is as nothing.
Yet truly, all things are vanity:
So then, truly man passes by like an image; even so,
he is disquieted in vain. He stores up,
thesaurizat, et ignorat cui congregabit ea.
and he knows not for whom he will gather these things.
Et nunc quæ est exspectatio mea:
And now, what is it that awaits me?
et substantia mea apud te est.
And my substance is with you.
Ab omnibus iniquitatibus meis erue me:
Rescue me from all my iniquities.
You have handed me over as a reproach to the foolish.
and I did not open my mouth,
because it was you who acted.
A fortitudine manus tuæ ego defeci in increpationibus:
I fall short at corrections from the strength of your hand.
For you have chastised man for iniquity.
Et tabescere fecisti sicut araneam animam ejus:
And you have made his soul shrink away like a spider.
Nevertheless, it is in vain that any man be disquieted.
heed my prayer and my supplication.
For I am a newcomer with you,
quoniam advena ego sum apud te,
et peregrinus sicut omnes patres mei.
just as all my fathers were.
so that I may be refreshed,
before I will go forth and be no more.
